Subject: Compliance audit of Exempted Establishments.

Sir,
A comprehensive compliance audit of the exempted establishments (u/s

17(1) or para 27 or para 27A) shall be undertaken by all officers-in-charge of ROs/SROs
during September and October, 2008. The audit shall cover the period till 31.3.2008
and shall be carried out by a team headed by an RPFC-II/APFC and shall extend to all
the establishments that are exempted or in respect of which the application of
exemption is under process. It must be ensured that the proforma for compliance audit
report as amended and enclosed herewith as Annexure-I is fifled up completely by the
audit team after examining the records thoroughly.

All the officers-in-charge shall be responsible for obtaining full information
in Annexure-I from the audit team and for taking consequent remedial/penal action, if
so warranted. RPFCs in charge of the regions and the ACC of the Zones shal! maintain
supervision over the above-mentioned remedial/penal action(s) against the erring
employers/establishments.

Where it emerges from the audit that the establishment has wilfully and
persistently violated the conditions of exemption or has otherwise attracted a condition
for revocation of exemption (e.g. condition no.29, para 27AA, EPF Scheme, 1952), the
RPFC/OIC shall proceed to recommend cancellation of exemption. In other cases, the
violations/defaults should be met with corrective and/or penal actions prescribed under
the law for such instances.

All the RPFCs/Officers-in-charge shalt meanwhile send to this office by
20.8.2008 a summarized information for the year 2007 in. respect of all the exempted
establishments pertaining to their offices in the format enclosed as Annexure-II. After
the compliance audit 2008 is over, similar information in Annexure-II shall be sent for
the year 2008, by 15.11.2008.

Yours faithfully,
